description: This Java source file implements a custom repository class for accessing loan capitalized income balance data within the Apache Fineract project. It provides methods to retrieve repayment period data for specific loan IDs, utilizing JPA for database queries and partitioned processing for large input lists.

classes.name: CustomizedLoanCapitalizedIncomeBalanceRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a custom repository for accessing loan capitalized income balance data, specifically providing functionality to find repayment periods for given loan IDs.

methods.name: findRepaymentPeriodDataByLoanIds
methods.description: Public method to fetch repayment period data for a list of loan IDs, partitioning the input list and merging results.

methods.name: doFindRepaymentPeriodDataByLoanIds
methods.description: Private helper method executing a database query to retrieve and group repayment period data for a subset of loan IDs.
